component.name: Resolve Ingest
component.summary: Archive camera originals and prepare verified PCM editing copies

description.p: Insert a camera card and Resolve Ingest selects the clips that are not archived yet. One click copies the originals to your archive, checks every byte, and creates DaVinci Resolve editing copies with unchanged video and 24-bit PCM audio.
Archives can be on a local disk, an external drive, or a network share. Existing footage can also be converted in place. A local journal supports recovery and retry.
